unlocks.name: Suq-a-nother One
unlocks.notes: Number of suqahs assigned is increased to 186-250.

variantInfo.name: Suqah
notes: Suqah are level 111, aggressive, 2x2 monsters with 105 Hitpoints and 107.6 Slayer XP.
They attack with Stab and Magic, have attack speed 6, and their max hit is 10.
The northern shield-bearing variety uses melee plus weaker Ice Barrage and Water Wave spells.
If Ice Barrage successfully casts while the player is not using Protect from Magic, it is guaranteed to hit 10 damage.
The melee-only variety dual-wields melee weapons and is found on the southern part of Lunar Isle.
The monster page lists a 20% elemental weakness to Earth spells and standard ranged defence lowered to 30.

locationComparison.name: North Lunar Isle
notes: Northern Lunar Isle contains 16 level 111 Suqah.
This is the preferred cannon location because the spawns are dense.
Use Protect from Magic here because northern Suqah attack with both melee and magic.
The task page shows a hill safespot for cannoning and ranging northern Suqah.

locationComparison.name: South-east Lunar Isle
notes: South-east Lunar Isle contains 4 level 111 Suqah.
The southern area is more sparse but avoids the northern magic attacks.
Three nearby Suqah in the south-west of the island only attack with melee.

locationComparison.name: South-west Lunar Isle
notes: South-west Lunar Isle contains 6 level 111 Suqah in single-way combat.
This row is cannonable and safespottable but not multicombat.
A cannon placed directly north-west of the dead tree targets melee-only Suqah while avoiding the nearby magic-using Suqah.

taskNotes: Suqah can be a good Slayer task due to the high amount of experience per hour gained with a dwarf multicannon.
Using a dwarf multicannon and toxic blowpipe or prayer potions can result in a loss of coins due to Suqah's lack of valuable drops.
If using the northern area on Lunar Isle, players should use Protect from Magic and high Melee defence.
Players wishing to avoid magic damage should fight the southern part of Lunar Isle because those Suqah attack with only melee.
Three melee-only Suqah are found on the south-west part of the island over the bridge by the city wall.
A cannon can be placed directly north-west of the dead tree in the south-west area to target melee-only Suqah while avoiding the single magic-using Suqah nearby.
A Seal of passage is required to use the Lunar Isle bank unless Dream Mentor or the Elite Fremennik Diary allows banker access.
A bonecrusher or bonecrusher necklace is useful because Suqah always drop big bones.
recommendedMethod: Use Ranged with a dwarf multicannon at North Lunar Isle for the fastest dense task, praying Protect from Magic and using the hill safespot. Use melee plus cannon on the southern or south-western Lunar Isle spawns when avoiding magic damage; Guthan's equipment can mitigate melee damage.
